description:
## Why

Foundation step of PKIX-9vnx.9. The check_shape() core lives in pkix-lint and is generic over any `LintProfile` implementor; convenience aliases in pkix-profiles / pkix-profiles-cabf (PKIX-9vnx.9.2) call into it.

The function answers "is this cert sanely shaped for X?" using only the per-cert lints of a profile — no chain walk, no signature verification, no I/O. O(number of lints) per call where each lint is a structural DER check.

## What

In `pkix-lint/src/lib.rs` (or a new top-level module `check_shape`):

```rust
/// Run the certificate-scope lints of `profile` against `cert` at the
/// supplied `now_unix` evaluation time. Returns `Ok(())` when no
/// Error or Fatal findings are produced; returns `Err(findings)`
/// otherwise, with the full Finding list (which may also include Warn
/// findings; callers can filter by `Finding::result` if they want
/// stricter or looser semantics).
///
/// This is a single-cert convenience layer over [`LintRunner::run_cert`]:
/// no path validation, no chain, no signature verification, no I/O.
pub fn check_shape(
    cert: &Certificate,
    kind: SubjectKind,
    now_unix: u64,
    profile: &dyn LintProfile,
) -> Result<(), Vec<Finding>>;
```

Implementation:

1. Resolve `profile.lint_runner()` to get a `LintRunner` carrying the profile's lint set.
2. Call `runner.run_cert(cert, kind, 0, now_unix)`.
3. Scan findings: if any `result` is Error or Fatal, return `Err(findings)`; otherwise `Ok(())`.

Public surface:

- Add `pub use` for `check_shape` at the crate root.
- Rustdoc must distinguish:
  - shape-check (single cert, fast, structural)
  - path-validation (chain, slow, full RFC 5280 §6 — via `pkix-path::validate_path`)
  - compliance-assertion (OSCAL Assessment Results, audit-trail — via `pkix_lint::oscal` emit)

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix_lint::check_shape` exists at the crate root.
- [ ] Tests with a synthetic `LintProfile` (e.g., wrap an existing `Rfc5280MaxSerialLengthLint` in a minimal profile struct):
  - cert that passes all lints → `Ok(())`
  - cert that triggers an Error finding → `Err` with the finding present
  - cert that triggers only a Warn finding → `Ok(())` per the contract (Warn is not failure)
- [ ] Rustdoc explains the three layers and links to `pkix_path::validate_path` and `pkix_lint::oscal::emit`.
- [ ] `cargo test -p pkix-lint --features oscal` clean.

## Out of scope

- Convenience aliases in pkix-profiles / pkix-profiles-cabf — PKIX-9vnx.9.2.
- Path-scope lints — `check_shape` is per-cert. Path-scope lints in the profile are skipped (run_cert already does this).
- Performance microbenchmark (the bead text suggests one; out of scope for this sub-bead, can be a follow-up).

## Depends on

PKIX-9vnx.6 (closed) — Lint trait + LintRunner exist.
title: pkix_lint::check_shape() core API: run profile lints against single cert
